title: 第13章 炼化丹药第14章 灵丹阁
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
看着秦天成没了最后一口气，秦伏天无波无澜。
倒是秦青瑶这小丫头惊喜不已。
没有想到少爷现在实力竟然这么强大，就连原本在她眼里高高在上的长老，都被少爷打死了。
秦伏天仔细将秦天成的灵戒搜罗了一遍。
金钱草、赤金笋、玉茯苓、地黄精……灵药可真不少，如果是按一株一份来算的话，接近有六十多份。
其中还有三份是二阶灵药。
倒是灵兽的内丹一共只有三颗，而且都是一阶灵兽的兽元，毕竟灵兽的兽元不好保存，通常风干之后保存药效会大打折扣。
所以一般有灵兽兽元，都会直接炼化，或者出售给丹药铺子。
而除了灵药和灵兽兽元之外，还有三瓶丹药。
丹药可是好东西。
尤其是在云仓这个偏僻之地，丹药更是难得。
一枚不入品级的蕴灵丹，就能够卖到两百两银子。
而一阶的聚灵丹，更是能够卖到千两银子的天价。
在云仓城这种地方，银子是真正的硬通货，毕竟没有踏入武道的普通人更多，普通人手中流通的货币，不就是银子？
当然，也还有黄金，只是黄金价值高昂，一两黄金就能兑换一百两纹银。
至于灵石……
在秦伏天的记忆当中，云仓城是很少有灵石这种高级货的。
秦伏天扒开丹药瓶的瓶塞，轻轻闻了闻。
“其中一个玉瓶里装的是三枚蕴灵丹，还有一瓶是三枚聚灵丹，最后一瓶是一枚归气丹。”
“小瑶，这蕴灵丹给你！”秦伏天将那瓶蕴灵丹直接递给秦青瑶。

对于秦伏天来说，蕴灵丹并没有什么作用。
蕴灵丹是主要作用是蕴养丹田，促进丹田对灵气的炼化吸收。
而秦伏天现在连真正意义上的丹田都没有，这蕴灵丹自然也就没有了用处。
至于聚灵丹，乃是帮助武修聚拢和吸纳灵气入体。
这个倒是有些用处，不过用处也不大，以《造化吞天诀》那吸纳天地灵气的恐怖速度，根本就不需要借助聚灵丹。
至于归气丹，应该有些用处。
归气丹的作用是帮助所有的灵气归纳在丹田之中，同时使得灵气进一步蜕变，如百川归海，从而帮助武者从通脉境突破到气海境。
“咦……”
秦伏天突然想到了一点。
既然造化神炉能够炼化灵草、灵兽兽元，那这些丹药又是否能够直接炼化？
炼化丹药的效果，和直接炼化灵草、兽元比起来又是如何？
当即，秦伏天将一枚聚灵丹握在掌心，运转起《造化吞天诀》。
下一刻聚灵丹便是被分解开来，接着在造化神炉当中，多出了三滴造化之水！
“这……”秦伏天不由得心中一喜。
炼制一炉聚灵丹，大概需要接近十份一阶灵药。
content_en:
Seeing Qin Tiancheng take his last breath, Qin Futian remained calm.
But the little girl Qin Qingyao was pleasantly surprised.
She didn't expect that the young master would be so powerful now. Even the elders who were originally superior in her eyes were beaten to death by the young master.
Qin Futian carefully searched Qin Tiancheng's spiritual rings.
Money grass, golden bamboo shoots, jade tuckahoe, rehmannia glutinosa... there are quite a lot of elixirs. If counted as one serving per plant, there are nearly sixty servings.
Three of them are second-level elixirs.
On the other hand, there are only three inner elixirs of spirit beasts, and they are all the beast essence of first-level spirit beasts. After all, the beast essence of spirit beasts is not easy to preserve, and the efficacy of the medicine will be greatly reduced after drying.
Therefore, if there are spirit beasts and beast essences, they will be directly refined or sold to elixir shops.
In addition to the elixir and spirit beast essence, there are also three bottles of elixir.
Pills are good things.
Especially in a remote place like Yuncang, pills are even more rare.
A low-grade Yunling Pill can be sold for two hundred taels of silver.
And the first-level Spirit Gathering Pill can be sold for a sky-high price of one thousand taels of silver.
In a place like Yuncang City, silver is the real hard currency. After all, there are more ordinary people who have not entered the martial arts. Isn't the currency circulating in the hands of ordinary people just silver?
Of course, there is also gold, but gold is very valuable. One tael of gold can be exchanged for one hundred taels of silver.
As for the spirit stone...
In Qin Futian's memory, there were very few high-end goods like spirit stones in Yuncang City.
Qin Futian opened the cork of the elixir bottle and smelled it gently.
"One of the jade bottles contains three spirit-accumulating pills, another one contains three spirit-gathering pills, and the last one contains a return-qi pill."
"Xiaoyao, I'll give you this Spirit-accumulating Pill!" Qin Futian handed the bottle of Spirit-accumulating Pill directly to Qin Qingyao.
For Qin Futian, Yunling Pill has no effect.
The main function of Yunling Pill is to nourish the Dantian and promote the refining and absorption of spiritual energy in the Dantian.
And Qin Futian now doesn't even have a Dantian in the true sense, so the Spirit Accumulating Pill is naturally of no use.
As for the Spirit Gathering Pill, it helps martial arts practitioners gather and absorb spiritual energy into the body.
This has some uses, but it's not very useful. With the terrifying speed of "The Art of Devouring the Sky" in absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, there is no need to resort to the Spirit Gathering Pill at all.
As for the Returning Qi Pill, it should be of some use.
The function of the Returning Qi Pill is to help all the spiritual energy be summarized in the Dantian, and at the same time make the spiritual energy further transform, like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, thereby helping the warrior break through from the Tongmai realm to the Qihai realm.
"Eh..."
Qin Futian suddenly thought of something.
Since the Divine Furnace of Creation can refine spiritual grass and spiritual beasts and beast essence, can these elixirs be directly refined?
How does the effect of refining elixirs compare with directly refining spiritual grass and beast essence?
Immediately, Qin Futian held a spirit-gathering elixir in his palm and started the "Good Fortune Swallowing Heaven Technique".
The next moment, the Spirit Gathering Pill was decomposed, and then three more drops of the Water of Creation appeared in the Divine Furnace of Creation!
"This..." Qin Futian couldn't help but feel happy.
To refine a furnace of Spirit-Gathering Pills, approximately ten first-level elixirs are needed.
